theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ), m + 1 < P → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ (K : Set (Euclid P)) (Q : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), IsCompact K → IsIntegerMultiplicity Q → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1))) ({x : Euclid P | ∃ s : Finset (Fin P), P ≤ m + 1 + s.card ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ z : ℤ, x i = z} ∩ K) → Q ω = 0) → Q.boundary.mass ≠ ∞ → ∃ (s : Finset ((Fin P → ℤ) × (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P))) (β : (Fin P → ℤ) × (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) → ℤ) (Pc : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), (∀ p ∈ s, StrictMono p.2) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), Pc ω = ∑ p ∈ s, (β p : ℝ) * ∫ x in {x : Euclid P | ∀ i : Fin P, (i ∈ Set.range p.2 → (p.1 i : ℝ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ p.1 i + 1) ∧ (i ∉ Set.range p.2 → x i = p.1 i)}, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) x (fun k => EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 k) (1 : ℝ)) ∂μHE[m + 1]) ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity (Q - Pc) ∧ (Q - Pc).mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c * Q.boundary.mass ∧ (∑ p ∈ s, ((β p).natAbs : ℝ≥0∞)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c * Q.mass ∧ (∀ p ∈ s, {x : Euclid P | ∀ i : Fin P, (i ∈ Set.range p.2 → (p.1 i : ℝ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ p.1 i + 1) ∧ (i ∉ Set.range p.2 → x i = p.1 i)} ⊆ cthickening (Real.sqrt P) K) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1))) (cthickening (Real.sqrt P) K) → (Q - Pc) ω = 0
